name: University of North Carolina at Wilmington
description:
The University of North Carolina Wilmington (UNCW) is a renowned coastal university. It was founded in 1947 to support local residents with higher education opportunities. In 1969, the establishment joined the University of North Carolina System. Today, around 15,000 students attend the university and it is ranked among the top 100 public national universities by U.S. News & World Report in 2023.

Currently UNCW offers a range of baccalaureate, master's level and doctoral programs. It has courses in Business, Data Science, Information Systems, Marine Biology and Psychology. UNCW is also the only US university that has a Coastal Engineering degree program.

What is the UNCW - University of North Carolina Wilmington acceptance rate?

The UNCW - University of North Carolina Wilmington acceptance rate is 68%.

highlights.title: Overview
highlights.value:
Northeastern University is a private university based in Boston, Massachusetts. It was founded in 1896 as the Evening Institute for Younger Men by the Boston YMCA. It became the Northeastern University in 1922 and began admitting women after World War II before separating from the YMCA in 1948. It features a ‘co-op’ education program with a mixture of classroom and professional experience through partnerships with businesses around the world.

It has more than 27,000 students including 20,000 international students, making it one of the biggest universities for students from more than 147 countries to come and study. Northeastern University has ranked in the top 100 national universities in lists from Forbes, Wall Street Journal, US News & World Report and Washington Monthly. It’s also in the top 200 global universities according to the Times Higher Education list and US News & World Report.

highlights.title: Accommodation
highlights.value: Students can choose from a variety of different housing options at UNCW. The university also has specific halls of residence for first-year students, sophomores and upperclassmen. Currently, undergraduate first-years can select a housing option from 11 different halls. These vary from shared rooms and facilities to private rooms and en-suite housing. Also, each halls of residence has laundry and vending facilities, WIFI and basic furnishings, like beds, wardrobes and study areas.
